relationships.subject: Hemopressin
relationships.evidence_quote: the increased synovial levels of MPO activity, total leukocytes number and IL-6, but not IL-1β, were significantly reduced by the lower i.art. dose of Hp

relationships.subject: Hemopressin
relationships.evidence_quote: There was a significant but not dose-dependent inhibitory effect produced by all dosages and routes of Hp treatments on AIA-induced knee joint swelling

key_findings: Hemopressin reduced knee swelling, impaired mobility, leukocyte influx and IL-6 in rat antigen-induced arthritis
Its effect was reported as unrelated to the proinflammatory actions of CGRP and substance P
